Place 64-bit Windows ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe here before building.
Binaries are not included in this source package.
Use a trusted build linked from https://ffmpeg.org/download.html#build-windows
Keep that exact build's license, notices and required corresponding-source information.
If using a shared-library build, place the required DLLs on PATH or adapt the spec to bundle them.
A static build is simpler to package; static does not automatically mean LGPL.
